text:
Maya Chen: Quick capture — onboarding call with ClearPath Health just finished. They gave three distinct asks that I want logged for product triage.
Maya Chen: 1) export: they need a per-route billing CSV (line items per model and route) for finance reconciliation.
Maya Chen: 2) evaluation: their onboarding eval shows big variance at 2-4k token contexts; they want a shorter churn window for early signals.
Maya Chen: 3) private models: they want to upload a customer-provided finetune/adapter to our Dedicated stack with scoped keys.
Samir Patel: thanks Maya. Can you paste verbatim quotes or example files? for priotization we need repro + how much impact (revenue/regulatory).
Diego Rivera: pasted notes from the call: "we need the export today or we'll have to build a manual mapping — 2 FTEs weekly" / "early eval mismatch blocks rollout to 50% of their pilot" / "security: we can't send model weights to any third party"
Elena Park: tagging severity: export = S2 (monetization friction), eval window = S3 (usability), model upload = S1 (deal blocker/regulatory).
Liam O'Neill: adding a quick telemetry sample for the export ask — if we include route_id + model_name + tokens + cost_usd in the CSV header we can cover 90% of their needs. snippet:
```
route_id,model_name,request_ts,user_id,prompt_tokens,completion_tokens,total_cost_usd
```
Liam O'Neill: also note: their CSV needs have custom naming conventions (department code prefixed).
Samir Patel: good details. Proposal: spin up a small export endpoint as an MVP (2-week spike) and scope model-upload design doc in parallel. Can product/eng estimate?
Diego Rivera: ClearPath willing to be a pilot — can trade prioritization for a short contract add-on (monthly fee).
ProductBot: summary created: "clearpath-onboard-2026-03-export-eval-model-upload" -> <https://redwood.company/feedback/board/9876> :white_check_mark:
Elena Park: action items: Maya to drop call recording + raw CSV example; Samir to slot in 30-min triage w/ eng; Liam to sketch export API contract; Diego to confirm pilot pricing ask.
Maya Chen: I'll upload the recording + sample CSV to the board by EOD. @Samir can you do triage tomorrow?
Samir Patel: yes — scheduling now, invite sent. :calendar:
Diego Rivera: thumbs up from ClearPath on being in the pilot, will confirm legal constraints on model upload.
Liam O'Neill: quick note for eng: if we do model upload, must support KMS-scoped keys and per-model isolation; that'll influence infra timeline.
Samir Patel: thanks all — keeping this open here so PMs and CS can update. If anyone gets more direct quotes or examples drop them in this thread. :thumbsup:
